name: MushroomProcess - Woo Pack and Dispatch - PGSQL

parameters.query:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('order_id',o.external_order_id,'site_key',o.site_key,
 'status',o.status,'currency',o.snapshot->>'currency','total',o.snapshot->>'total','payment_processor',o.snapshot->>'payment_processor','confirmed',o.reservation_confirmed,'fulfilled',o.fulfilled,'lines',o.snapshot->'lines',
 'packages',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('reference',k.reference,'state',k.state,'method',k.method,'tracking',k.tracking,'picks',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(unit) FROM (
 SELECT p.line_id,product.product_id AS code FROM mp_commerce_picks p JOIN products product ON product.nocopk=p.product_id
 WHERE (p.provider,p.site_key,p.reference)=(k.provider,k.site_key,k.reference)
 UNION ALL SELECT p.line_id,lot.lot_id FROM mp_commerce_lot_picks p JOIN lots lot ON lot.nocopk=p.lot_id
 WHERE (p.provider,p.site_key,p.reference)=(k.provider,k.site_key,k.reference)) unit),'[]'::jsonb)))
 FROM mp_commerce_packages k WHERE (k.provider,k.site_key,k.external_order_id)=(o.provider,o.site_key,o.external_order_id)),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) ORDER BY o.external_order_id),'[]'::jsonb) AS orders FROM mp_commerce_orders o
 WHERE o.provider='woocommerce' AND o.site_key='danks.store' AND (o.reservation_confirmed OR (o.snapshot->>'payment_processor'='cash' AND o.status IN ('pending','on-hold','processing','completed') AND jsonb_array_length(o.snapshot->'refunds')=0))
